title: Cognitive Function of Alcoholic Compensated Liver Cirrhosis
brief_summary: Differences in cognitive function between patients with viral and alcoholic compensated liver cirrhosis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Those who agreed to participate in this study and signed a written consent
* Those who have no evidence of neurological impairment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Those who have decompensated liver cirrhosis
* Those who have a high MELD score (≥20)
* Those who have OHE during admission
* Those who have parients' refusal
study_population: All of them are agree to provide it to investigation.
